documents.title: Information memorandum
documents.text:
Information memorandum — Osprey Partners (fictional).
In this document "OPH" means Osprey Partners. Osprey Partners reports annual customer churn of 17.3% for FY2024. Osprey Partners reports headcount of 2400.792 for FY2024. Osprey Partners reports earn out of $65.731m for FY2025 on a reported basis. Osprey Partners reports normalised net working capital of $81.6m for FY2025 on a reported basis under the original agreement. For Osprey Partners, the leakage definition is read as: permitted leakage excludes management bonuses. For Osprey Partners, the form of consideration is: part-share consideration with a 12-month lock-up.

documents.title: Financial due diligence report
documents.text:
Financial due diligence report — Osprey Partners (fictional).
Osprey Partners reports annual customer churn of 21.8% for FY2025. Osprey Partners reports headcount of 2396 for FY2024. Osprey Partners reports revenue of $468.7m for FY2024 on a reported basis. OPH reports enterprise value of $1290.7m for FY2024 on a reported basis. For Osprey Partners, the leakage definition is read as: management bonuses are permitted leakage up to $2m. For Osprey Partners, the form of consideration is: all-cash consideration.

Draft share purchase agreement — Osprey Partners (fictional).
Osprey Partners reports earn out of $65.6m for FY2025 on a reported basis. Osprey Partners reports normalised net working capital of $65m for FY2025 on a reported basis under the amendment no. 1 (supersedes). Osprey Logistics subsidiary reports revenue of $595.1m for FY2024 on a reported basis. Osprey Partners reports enterprise value of $1486.2m for FY2024 on a reported basis.
